Below it, the rattan front/side face runs rows 19-26 (8 rows) with a darker eave band at 19-20. The armrest band at rows 10-12 has its own edge line at row 12. styleAnswer.evidence: The measured facts favour the candidate. It has 19 distinct colours, more than the bench (14), hedge (11) and lamp (14) references, and fewer than the stall (40) and well (38). Its median of 13 colours per 16x16 tile sits between the hedge (10) and the stall (17). Flat-fill coverage is 0%, and 0% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outlines are tinted rather than the sticker-style near-black. The two chairs read as rattan frames with lighter cushions, with weave dots and several tan-to-brown steps (roughly 4-5), and the small dark table is separated by value. The picture is small and I could not make out fine detail, so the texture is rated 'some' rather than 'rich', and the shading is a little shallower than the best Beodeul pieces. It would sit acceptably next to the bench and hedge references, so it passes.
